records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade Animal rescue incidents attended by LFB dataset. It contains animal-rescue special-service incidents from January 2009 through July 2026 and supplies location information including postcode, borough and ward. This batch binds verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused official ward-capable source window without extracting incident rows, geometry, parcel joins or parcel progress.
